mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP signals a contraction in economic activity that will negatively impact corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving S&P 500 returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a 1%+ qoq GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand, which will pressure corporate revenues and drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in periods following a 0.5pp+ 2-month rise in UNRATE (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity and corporate earnings, which will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of INDPRO vs. SPX 20-day forward returns remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will increase borrowing costs and pressure equity valuations, driving S&P 500 returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances following a 0.5pp+ 3-month rise in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in retail sales signals a severe drop in consumer demand that will crush corporate revenues and drive S&P 500 returns sharply lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in the 20 days following a 5%+ mom drop in RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market and rising consumer demand, which will boost corporate revenues and drive S&P 500 returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 30% of instances following a 300k+ mom rise in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in housing starts signals a severe contraction in residential investment that will drag on economic growth and drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in the 60 days following a 10%+ yoy drop in HOUST (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation signals rising input costs and consumer prices that will erode corporate profit margins and drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in the 20 days following a 0.5%+ mom rise in CPIAUCSL (t-test p > 0.05).
